name: omany
author: Brito
description: Every AI agent opens the same way: inside Herdr, one tab per agent, four key slots, and the Omarchy skill loaded on the first turn.

barWidget.description: Panel to open your agents in Herdr: default, the other one, two free slots, what is running, and settings.

schema.label: Position
schema.description: Where the icon sits on the bar. Center puts it right after the clock.

schema.label: Agent (A)
schema.description: Agent for left slot A and Super+Ctrl+Shift+A. Omarchy follows your Omarchy default agent; picking one here changes only omany.

schema.label: Other agent
schema.description: Agent for right-click and the second key. Auto swaps Claude Code and Codex.

schema.label: Slot S agent
schema.description: Optional agent for Super+Ctrl+Shift+S. Empty until you pick one. Suggestions: Hermes, Grok and OpenClaw (Omarchy can install them), Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot.

schema.label: Slot X agent
schema.description: Optional agent for Super+Ctrl+Shift+X. Empty until you pick one. Suggestions: Hermes, Grok and OpenClaw (Omarchy can install them), Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot.

schema.label: Herdr workspace
schema.description: Label of the Herdr workspace where agents open.

schema.label: Working folder
schema.description: Empty uses the same rule as omarchy agent (~/Work when launched from home).

schema.label: Load the Omarchy skill
schema.description: Send /omarchy (Claude Code) or $omarchy (Codex) on the first turn.
